entities.summary: Yevgeniya Aleksandrovna Startseva is a volleyball player from Russia. She was a member of the national team that won the gold medal at the 2010 World Championship. She represented Russia at the 2012 Olympics. Yevgeniya Startseva was a athletes & competitors from Chelyabinsk (b. 1989-02-12, Chelyabinsk). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
